title: dryopteris mollicula
intro: Dryopteris mollicula, commonly known as the hairy male fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antifungal agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents of Dryopteris mollicula include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
